decisions.reason: Turnaround management builds directly on the firm's docking and gate knowledge. That lets it interpret field results and keep refining the product, and the product has its own dedicated page.

Apron connectivity is an enabling layer for the firm's integrated data platform. In-house R&D can absorb customer feedback on it, though as a supporting module it faces some risk of being folded into other offerings.
Equipment monitoring draws on the firm's installed-base and maintenance expertise. It feeds learning from field data and strengthens the lifecycle service business.
Apron resource management is close to the established offer and fits the push toward automated airside operations, so the firm can assimilate feedback effectively.
The controller safety alert service extends the firm's tower and surveillance know-how. Its R&D capability supports interpreting results and improving this safety-critical offering.
